title: MZ So I'm thinking of making a community game

posts.author: Zeq
posts.body:
Spoiler:
First Posting
So, like, I'm thinking of making a community game, to show appreciation for RPG Maker communities and people that I know irl, with also public figures and influencers around the world. I got this idea firstly I thot of it in 2012, but recently am going to give it another try after I noticed most, if not all, characters in VisuStella sample game, are members of this amazing community.
So yeah, basically, I'm gonna do the same thing, but a lil bit larger scale, like, I'm gonna include Green Day, Sum 41. Blink 182, Avril, Sheeran, Breath of Fire, Suikoden, Square Enix, some anime and manga and novels at least...
I'd really hope you won't sue me if I include you in this game
Would you all be down for it? If yes, what kind of character and backstory you wanna have.
If you dont want to be included, pls post here tell me so that I know which people to include.
This game's going to be community service kind of thing. Some of the community that I really wanna see have their action in this game are
@Touchfuzzy
@Archeia
@Ms Littlefish
and...I'm scared to even mention more fraid that you'll be annoyed by me xD
So yeah, you down for it? Yay or nay, response.
Proof of Concept: 17th February 2025 (Happy Birthday Billy Joe Armstrong)
First Demo: 15th April (My birthday)
EDIT: Lemme prepare something substantial first before making another post...

posts.body:
Renzoffeyzenki said:
@Touchfuzzy @Archeia @Ms Littlefish and...I'm scared to even mention more fraid that you'll be annoyed by me xD
Click to expand...
So, I think making this "opt out" is a bad idea.
The way you have set this up is that everyone is included whether they want to or not.
This has the problem of
1) people may not even see this thread to begin with,and with you being "afraid" to mention more, that means they won't know because you didn't tag them.
2) even if they were tagged, it puts them in an awkward position because now they have to tell you "no, I'm not interested." which, for some may come easier than others. Some may feel like they are being rude or may hurt you by saying they aren't interested which puts them in a really uncomfortable position.
It would be better if you made this "opt in", and basically just ask people whether they want to join or not.
For a bit of my personal opinion on this, there is also a problem if you let
anyone
be part of this game.
It's your game, so you are free to run it however you want, but when new users or inactive members drop by and you just include them, this seems to not only muddy the waters of what the game is supposedly meant to be, it also associates everyone with that person.
1) The game is supposedly a celebration of the community, so I feel like you'd want to give priority to the members of the community that have contributed the most. Sorry to the newbies, but they haven't contributed much (yet, their time will come) so it seems weird to throw them into your game alongside people who have actually made a tangible difference to RM and the RMW community.
2) By including those more active members, we also have a better sense of who they are, so hopefully you aren't putting absolute degenerates next to other people who would rather not be associated with that person. When a user is new, we have no idea who they are and whether we want to associate our names/brands with them. That's not to say they definitely are a degenerate, but you do run the risk of that when you include any person who just swings by and says "pick me!"
Like I said, it's your game, and you can decide who you want to include or not, but figured I'd share my voice as a member of the community.
P.S.
Consider this post as me officially opting out of this game.

Yeah, automatically including people without asking them is a big no-no, especially for a collaborative project like this. Like I sure would find it distasteful if you added me in without bothering to check if I was cool with this or not.
A community project can only really work if you build that trust, instead of assuming it beforehand. Better to get the slight shame of "No, I'm not interested" instead of the potential mess someone could make over being included against their consent.
... That said, this is also my offical opt out.

I definitely am appreciative  that you enjoy my posting. Unfortunately, my stance on this doesn't change, as I don't really want to be represented in your game. I don't really feel like I have that much prestige within the community. 5% of my posts are dad lectures, 5% of my posts are the few times I beat one of the regular (and much smarter) contributors to a newbie question I am capable of answering, and the last 90% of my posts are sh/t posts.
I really haven't contributed that much to the community that merits being immortalized within someone else's game.
So, by opting out this frees up space for someone more deserving - someone who truly has done a lot, such as the many people who write code for people without asking for anything in return, or the many prolific creators who post tileset after tileset, character sheet after character sheet, or the many helpful people who know the engine inside and out.
So, while I appreciate the offer, please refrain from including me in your game.
I heard ATT Turan is really into the idea of being immortalized.
